security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting, documented API authentication, platform identifiers, or readable Chinese text rather than malicious behavior. The command examples execute an unpinned npm package with access to the API credential. Polling also lacks a time or attempt limit; no evidence found of prompt injection or credential exfiltration in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The command examples automatically execute the latest npm package version with inherited environment credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance, and obtain execution approval before exposing SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY to the CLI.

remediation.issue: Polling continues until a terminal result without a maximum duration or attempt count.
remediation.suggestion: Add an elapsed-time budget, attempt limit, and capped polling delay; return the existing job identifier when the budget expires.

content.user_title: Extract Short Video Transcripts and Copy
content.value_statement: Manually transcribing short videos makes content review slow. This skill uses SocialDataX to retrieve transcripts, preserve source context, and organize reusable copy.
actual_capabilities: Route public Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, and WeChat Channels videos to platform-specific transcription commands.
Accept video links, share text, platform content identifiers, or an existing job identifier.
Submit transcription tasks and query the same job until a terminal state.
Organize returned video metadata, original descriptions, and spoken transcripts without inventing missing fields.
Prepare copyable text and a concise summary from successful transcription results.
Use corresponding submission and status tools when SocialDataX MCP tools are already connected.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance; CLI execution also requires Node.js and npm.
The documented CLI supports only five platforms and does not cover arbitrary video sites or local video files.
Results depend on service availability and returned data; the skill cannot guarantee transcription accuracy or recover unavailable video resources.
The bundled files provide instructions only; external CLI implementation, service behavior, and transcription quality were not verified in this audit.

use_cases.title: Prepare Copy From Your Videos
use_cases.description: Extract a spoken transcript and copyable text from your public short video while preserving its original description.

use_cases.title: Review Public Video Messaging
use_cases.description: Organize returned titles, descriptions, transcripts, and short summaries for reviewing individual public campaign videos.

use_cases.title: Collect Source Text for Analysis
use_cases.description: Retrieve a public video transcript with available source metadata and explicitly mark information the service did not return.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the transcript from this public Douyin video: [video link]. Preserve spoken order and mark missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: retrieve text from one supported video.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Copy From Share Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Xiaohongshu share text: [share text]. Return available video metadata, the original description, transcript, copyable text, and a concise summary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare structured copy from a shared video.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Existing Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume Weibo transcription job [job identifier]. Query the existing task without submitting again. Report the terminal result or explain any interruption.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: continue work without duplicate submissions.

prompt_templates.title: Extract With Resource Limits
prompt_templates.prompt: Process WeChat Channels content identifier [encrypted object identifier]. Poll for at most five minutes, then return the job identifier. Separate source text from summaries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: preserve source distinctions and bound polling time.

output_examples.input: Illustrative successful Douyin result: description is 'Desk setup'; spoken text is 'Keep the screen at eye level.'
output: Platform: Douyin. Title, author, publication date, duration, and source link: not returned.
Spoken transcript: Keep the screen at eye level.
Copyable text: Keep the screen at eye level.
Concise summary: Position the screen at eye level.

output_examples.input: Illustrative interrupted query: Weibo job example-42 remains queued, and the user requests a stop.
output: Polling stopped at your request. Query this same Weibo job later without submitting the video again.

best_practices: Keep SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY in the environment and approve only a reviewed, pinned CLI version before execution.
Reuse the same platform and job identifier; set a polling budget and respect the returned polling delay.
Separate original descriptions, transcripts, and summaries; verify transcription accuracy before publishing or quoting.
anti_patterns: Do not resubmit a video after receiving a job identifier or repeatedly retry an insufficient-balance error.
Do not invent missing metadata, deliver unfinished transcripts, or infer unsupported platform commands.
Do not paste API keys into prompts or interpolate untrusted share text directly into shell commands.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The documented CLI covers public Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, and WeChat Channels videos.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Provide SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient service balance. The direct CLI needs Node.js, npm, and network access; connected MCP tools offer another route.

faq.question: Can I provide share text or a content identifier?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply a supported video link, share text, platform content identifier, or existing job identifier, using only one input type per call.

faq.question: What happens if transcription is still running?
faq.answer: Query the same job after the suggested delay. Use a time limit and retain the job identifier when stopping.

faq.question: Does this skill change my social media account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow submits transcription jobs and queries their status. It does not instruct login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes.

faq.question: Are transcripts guaranteed to be complete and accurate?
faq.answer: No. Outputs depend on the service response and available video resources. Review transcripts and mark missing metadata rather than inventing details.
